# Collect the 2 green blocks
for (r,c) in [(51,39),(51,45)]:
    res = action([{'action':'MOUSE','row':r,'col':c}])
    ng = sum(1 for n in current_frame.segmentation['nodes'] if n['color']=='N')
    print(f'MOUSE({r},{c}): ngreens={ng} done={res.get("done")}')
# Now move LEFT toward the pink object at col ~21
# Creature at col 34, pink at col 21 -> need ~13 LEFT moves
for i in range(13):
    res = action(['LEFT'])
    r1 = current_frame.ascii.split('\n')
    ys = [(i,j) for i in range(64) for j in range(64) if r1[i][j]=='Y']
    ps = [(i,j) for i in range(64) for j in range(64) if r1[i][j]=='P']
    print(f'LEFT {i+1}: Y={ys} P={ps} no_impact={res.get("no_impact")} done={res.get("done")}')
    if res.get('done') or res.get('no_impact'): break
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
